Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Atlas' priorities around faster triage for inbound referrals and lowering per-case review time. Quick recap and next steps below so we keep momentum:

- Review flow: referral intake -> automated triage -> clinician review
- Main win: reduce manual review time by ~30–40% through embeddings + reranking for prioritized cases
- Success metric: time-to-decision and % of high-priority cases auto-escalated

What I’m sending
- Demo recording (20m) + Redwood slides attached
- Short checklist for production questions (data residency, SLA needs, estimated QPS) — will follow in a separate doc if you want it now

Quick ask / next steps
- Would you be open to a 15–20 minute Q&A next week to answer any product or integration questions? I can do: Tue 8/18 at 10:00am PT or Wed 8/19 at 2:00pm PT. If neither works, tell me a time window and I’ll send a calendar invite.
- Also: is this still a priority for Atlas in the next 60 days, or should I adjust cadence?

Attachments: atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (20:58), Redwood-demo-slides.pdf (12 slides, 4MB)

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.
